_readme: Replace appId and every DLC id with the App IDs that Steamworks gives you (see docs/NAVOD_STEAM.md). 480 = Valve's public test app 'Spacewar', useful only for testing lobbies before you have your own App ID. A DLC id of 0 means 'not configured' and that DLC counts as not owned. 'depots' are the depot IDs from Steamworks > SteamPipe > Depots (usually appId+1 for Windows).
